title: Toshiba (Vestel) Cosmos, Android TV 11 — Spain-market unit, UK/multi-market firmware
header:
Toshiba (Vestel) Cosmos, Android TV 11 — Spain-market unit, UK/multi-market firmware
ro.product.model=Cosmos  ro.product.name=Cosmos170  ro.product.device=yeoksam  brand/manufacturer=Vestel
Fingerprint: Vestel/Cosmos170/yeoksam:11/RTOC.251019.001/14296264:user/release-keys
Build date 2025-10-20, security patch 2025-08-01, SDK 30, MediaTek platform, ro.config.low_ram=true (~1 GB).

Match on the Vestel/Cosmos170/yeoksam fingerprint, not on the Toshiba badge: Vestel ships this
firmware across several European badge brands (Toshiba, JVC, Hitachi, Telefunken...). A Toshiba
Fire TV (examples/toshiba-fire-tv-aftha004) is a completely different platform; nothing here applies.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/toshiba-cosmos-android-tv/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/toshiba-cosmos-android-tv/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (pass it to restore.sh, as above).
Live TV app:    com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter (.nav.TurnkeyUiMainActivity) — NEVER disable it.
NOT the live TV app: com.cltv.fast ("FAST" streaming channels, iWedia). Its activities ship
disabled by Vestel (disabledComponents), so it looks launchable in the resolver table but is not.
Keep also: com.vestel.tv.service, com.vestel.tv.backlight, com.vestel.tv.keycontroller (hardware),
com.vestel.tv.servicepatch + com.vestel.tv.rcupdater (firmware/remote updates, owner keeps updates),
com.mediatek.tvinput, com.mediatek.tv.service, com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter,
com.mediatek.tvinputservice.arbitratorservice (tuner/HDMI plumbing),
com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast built-in, owner uses it).

QUIRKS ON THIS FIRMWARE:
- screencap prints "Init wrapper sys mutex successful..." junk to stdout before the PNG, so
`adb exec-out screencap -p` is corrupt. Use `screencap -p /sdcard/x.png` + `adb pull` instead.
- Port 5555 is closed until USB debugging has been toggled/authorised; it opened without a
separate Network-debugging switch on this unit. No Wireless-debugging (pairing) menu exists.
- The uk.co.freeview.* pack (BBC, ITV, Ch4/5, Freeview explore...) ships already disabled on
Spain-market units; it is not listed below because `pm list packages -d` already held it.
- The remote's YouTube and Prime Video buttons are handled by Vestel firmware below Android: the
IR driver logs "u4IRKey after convert: 0xffffffff" and no keycode reaches InputDispatcher
(getevent shows scancodes 0x129/0x13e, but the IR device's vendor keylayout drops them). With
their apps disabled the buttons simply do nothing; no launcher key service can remap them.
- Volume keys do reach Android (KEY_VOLUMEUP/DOWN on event0), but the firmware changes the volume
before the accessibility filter and never passes them on, so no app (InputKeyService included)
can replace the system volume slider.
- The TV closes Wi-Fi (and ADB with it) in standby. Accessibility services survived days of
standby cycles; only a force-stop of the launcher switched InputKeyService off.
- No microphone (no android.hardware.microphone) and an IR-only remote, so voice comes from a
phone or Nest speaker ("Hey Google, ... on the TV"). That needs katniss: keep it if you use it.
